neighbours.label: verbs reporting a proposal or suggestion by researchers (' suggested', ' proposed')
fire: In the paper, the authors suggested that diet explains the gap.
Several biologists have proposed using bacteria to clean the soil.
The researchers suggested that warmer seas drive the migration.
Engineers proposed a lighter frame for the new bridge.
Some historians have suggested that the fire was deliberate.
Doctors proposed a shorter course of antibiotics for children.
The team suggested that sleep loss affects memory in mice.
Astronomers have proposed that the planet has a thin atmosphere.
quiet: In the paper, the authors measured how diet changes the gap.
Several biologists have studied bacteria in the soil.
The researchers observed warmer seas during the migration.
Engineers built a lighter frame for the new bridge.
Some historians have written about the fire in detail.
Doctors gave a shorter course of antibiotics to children.
The team tested how sleep loss affects memory in mice.
Astronomers have photographed the planet with a new telescope.
